review_verdict.summary: The reported honeycomb failure was a false diagnosis; independent model, coordination, bandwidth, symmetry, and browser checks all pass. The renderer, worker recovery, legends, progressive display, interaction, topology-availability, BZ, Wannier, and linked-momentum findings were confirmed and repaired.

friend_claims.claim: The honeycomb model is simulating decoupled zigzag chains.
friend_claims.evidence: Native Γ eigenvalues are exactly (-3, +3); K and K′ are zero-energy Dirac points; a bulk site has three equal-length nearest-neighbor bonds; q=47 spans [-2.961660, +2.961660] with 4,324 states and visible gaps. The browser lattice contains 133 links for its finite 98-site patch.

friend_claims.claim: The worker can enter an unrecoverable runtime-not-initialized state and wipes valid data.
friend_claims.evidence: The engine now classifies lost-runtime/endpoint failures, recreates the worker, reinitializes Pyodide, and retries once. A deterministic unit test forces that exact failure. Completed butterfly, band, and lattice results remain visible until a replacement succeeds.

friend_claims.claim: Resizing can leave axes and one stray WebGL point.
friend_claims.evidence: R3F was resetting the orthographic camera to a pixel frustum on resize. CameraSync now owns a manual physical frustum and responds to canvas size. q=97 retained all 9,312 states after resizing to 900 px; the WebGL regression asserts more than 500 non-background pixels.

friend_claims.claim: Butterfly batches do not render progressively.
friend_claims.evidence: The same camera reset made streamed points collapse visually. The driven q=97 capture shows 291 rendered states at 3% while computation is still running.

friend_claims.claim: Legends, a current-flux line, and a linked 3D momentum marker are missing.
friend_claims.evidence: Energy, Chern (-10 to +10), Wannier gap-size/Hall, and 3D surface scales are present. Every sweep shows the current p/q line. Clicking k=(0.271, 0.500) on the cut moved both the SVG marker and the luminous 3D surface marker.

friend_claims.claim: Interaction and visualization polish is incomplete.
friend_claims.evidence: Plain wheel/trackpad zoom works, pan is bounded, drag release does not inspect, double-click and a visible button reset the view, band SVG text cannot be selected, Wannier dot area follows gap width, and q-folded BZs are shown against the ordinary BZ.

baseline_findings.finding: R3F resize reset the butterfly camera to a pixel-space frustum, collapsing progressive and resized point clouds.
baseline_findings.evidence: At 900 px the axes remained but the WebGL layer showed one point; incoming state counters continued to grow.
baseline_findings.resolution: The orthographic camera is manual, synchronized in a layout effect, and explicitly keyed to R3F canvas size.

baseline_findings.finding: A lost Pyodide worker/runtime had no automatic recovery and recomputation cleared the last valid plot.
baseline_findings.evidence: The failure string matched “The Python runtime is not initialized.”
baseline_findings.resolution: Recoverable worker failures trigger one clean worker recreation and retry; a retry control remains available and stale results stay visible.

baseline_findings.finding: Unsupported fast Diophantine coloring for multi-basis butterfly models was displayed as physical C=0.
baseline_findings.evidence: Kagome and higher-neighbor honeycomb butterflies received zero-filled topology arrays.
baseline_findings.resolution: The adapter sends an explicit topology_available contract; the UI disables and labels Chern mode as unavailable and exports blank Chern cells.

baseline_findings.finding: Dense scientific plots lacked color semantics and linked reference markers.
baseline_findings.resolution: Added energy, Chern, Hall/gap-width, and surface color scales, a current-flux line, and a linked symmetry-cut/3D momentum marker.

baseline_findings.finding: Unbounded pan, drag-release inspection, missing reset behavior, and selectable band-axis text made plot interaction brittle.
baseline_findings.resolution: Pan bounds, drag suppression, plain wheel zoom, double-click/button reset, and SVG selection hygiene are now regression-covered.

baseline_findings.finding: Wannier gaps had uniform visual weight and large-q magnetic BZ labels collided in a to-scale sliver.
baseline_findings.resolution: Wannier point area/alpha now scales with gap width; the reciprocal panel leads with the ordinary BZ and overlays the q-folded magnetic BZ with a clear legend.

baseline_findings.finding: The three-column result deck overflowed the document by 26 px at a 900 px viewport.
baseline_findings.resolution: The deck switches to a two-column layout below 1120 px and one column below 760 px; the final 900 px document has no horizontal overflow.

baseline_findings.finding: Invalid p/q and zero angle denominators could reach Pyodide.
baseline_findings.resolution: Central parameter normalization enforces coprime-range scalar bounds before URL writing or computation.

baseline_findings.finding: A reciprocal primitive parallelogram was labeled as the first Brillouin zone and q·a₂ escaped the SVG panel.
baseline_findings.resolution: The adapter constructs Wigner–Seitz cells for ordinary and magnetic reciprocal lattices; the magnetic real-space cell is a bounded inset.

baseline_findings.finding: Individual Berry/Chern values were shown for touching Kagome and honeycomb bands.
baseline_findings.resolution: Touching bands use the upstream non-Abelian determinant-link formulation and are labeled as gauge-invariant groups.

baseline_findings.finding: Cancelled computations could later overwrite the terminal cancelled state.
baseline_findings.resolution: Cancellation is terminal locally and worker bookkeeping is cleared after every request.

final_checks.detail: Γ=(-3,+3), K=K′=(0,0), bulk coordination=3, q47 range=[-2.961660,+2.961660], chiral symmetry error=8.7e-15.
98 sites, 133 rendered bonds, a rhombic two-site primitive cell, ordinary hexagonal BZ, and magnetic BZ.
291 square-lattice q=97 states were visibly rendered at 3% before completion.
9,312 q=97 states remained populated after a 900 px resize; automated WebGL readback exceeded 500 foreground pixels.
The sweep axes mark the current p/q and keep the label within the plotting frame.
A 21-step Chern scale labels -10, 0, and +10, matching the documented HofstadterTools default magnitude.
A plain wheel event changed physical tick domains without Ctrl; the reset button restored the initial domains.
9,216 q=97 gaps use point area and alpha proportional to gap width, exposing the large Landau-fan trajectories.
Honeycomb q=89 shows a readable ordinary hexagonal BZ with the magnetic BZ overlaid and labeled folded ×89.
Clicking the symmetry cut moved its marker to x=464.789 and updated the surface to k=(0.271,0.500); the 3D marker and drop line are visible.
Band 1 E(k) displays its active range [-2.966,-2.902].
A forced runtime-not-initialized failure terminated endpoint 1, initialized endpoint 2, and successfully retried computeLattice once.
Unit tests verify old butterfly, band, and lattice results survive recompute startup and are replaced only by the first valid new result.
Kagome q=11 renders 330 energy states and exposes a disabled “Chern unavailable” control rather than physical zero.
Every gap satisfies r=q·s+p·t for p/q=22/89 and 15/47.
Honeycomb and Kagome grouped Chern values are stable from 7×7 to 11×11 grids and every complete bundle sums to C=0.
Every scientific parameter and active view round-trips through the URL.
Cancellation stays terminal; CSV, NPZ, and composed WebGL+SVG PNG downloads have deterministic scientific filenames.
No document overflow at 900 px or 430 px; the 430 px navigation owns its bounded horizontal scroll.
Named controls and graphical regions, one H1, complete landmarks, a polite live status region, reduced motion, and AA contrast tokens.

additional_checks.detail: Full pytest, Vitest, Pyodide parity, desktop/mobile Playwright, physics, accessibility, and production-build checks all pass.
No application exceptions occurred; React Three Fiber emits only the known upstream THREE.Clock deprecation warning.
The app follows the documented Γ-point butterfly sweep, ±10 Chern default, gap-width Wannier sizing, 1×q MUC convention, and Γ/K/M/K′ reference paths.

limitations.reason: Semantic native controls, accessible names, focus-outline CSS, reduced-motion handling, and desktop/mobile Playwright interaction were verified; a separate assistive-technology session was not run.
THREE.Clock is deprecated upstream; no application error or rendering fault accompanies the warning.
